causal_identification.forbidden_claim: cause-specific neurologic action effect or recommendation

actions.identifiability_reason: The generic neurologic dysfunction process does not identify a cause-specific safe intervention.
actions.label: cause-specific neurologic intervention (outside generic process resolution)

allowed_inputs: frozen broad scope supplied by coordinator

epistemic.unknown_prior_semantics: toy prior mass; not a calibrated OOD probability

identifiability.forbidden_action_output: unique patient-level untreated outcome, treatment benefit magnitude, or clinical recommendation

measurement_factor_policy.alternative_representation_contract: within one alternative_representation_group_id and source_result_id, consume exactly one representation, preferring the method-valid numeric measurement
measurement_factor_policy.censoring_contract: censored or detection-limit results require an explicit mapper representation; do not coerce to an exact number
measurement_factor_policy.method_contract: required_provenance_fields and method_requirement must be satisfied before mapping
measurement_factor_policy.mnar_contract: not tested, unknown, negative, treatment-masked negative, and low-sensitivity negative are distinct
measurement_factor_policy.numeric_unit_contract: consume only values normalized to the unit declared by the concept
measurement_factor_policy.runtime_boundary: runtime does not infer these conditions; the case-blind mapper/harness must enforce them and record residuals
measurement_factor_policy.support_masking_contract: if an active action can mask an observation and no conditioned factor is declared, withhold the emission and raise measurement_uncertainty

no_new_action_dynamics.semantics: apply process-local mode drift, process/mode couplings, and residual effects of already-performed actions; start no new exposure

observations.method_requirement: assay_and_clock_time_documented; pre-exogenous-steroid value or marked measurement uncertainty

parameter_epistemology.action_effects: directional mechanism placeholders; not identified causal effects
parameter_epistemology.drifts_and_couplings: directional toy dynamics; not fitted rates
parameter_epistemology.likelihoods: likelihood-shaped ordinal evidence weights; not sensitivity, specificity, or probability calibration
parameter_epistemology.objective: toy burden functional; not utility, mortality benefit, or recommendation

scope.epsilon: unset; no clinical equivalence or safety tolerance claimed
scope.horizon_semantics: 0-24 ordinal runtime steps; step duration is not clinically calibrated

scope.tolerance_semantics: runtime determinism only; clinical epsilon is unset
scope.utility: ordinal coordinate burden plus toy action cost
